title.en: Defining the Role, Duties and Responsibilities of Chiefs of Divisions in the Departments and Agencies of the Government and Regularizing their Appointments

text.en:
As used in this Decree, "Chief of Division" shall refer to the incumbent of a position in the
second level of the career civil service, whether in a department or agency or local government, which has the
responsibility of overseeing the work of an organizational unit charged with a major and specialized activity.

A Chief of Division shall be appointed to a position whose nomenclature reflects the expertise
required in his area of work but such position shall be specifically referred to as a "Chief of Division"

These functions shall be performed by a Chief of Division in accordance with guidelines,
policies and standards set by his higher supervisors and as contained in laws and policies governing his
Further, in the performance of these functions, the Chief of Division shall be responsible and accountable to
his higher supervisors.

The Chief of Division shall be required to submit semi-annually an action program for his
division based upon the broad policy guidelines of the Office to which his Division belongs, which shall be
arrived at in consultation with his employees, the accomplishments of which shall form the basis for the
evaluation of the performance of the Division, of himself, and that of his employees.

A sound comprehensive method for the selection of Chief of Division shall be established by the
Civil Service Commission which shall be supplemented and reinforced by thorough and continuous training
by the departments and agencies of such Chiefs and prospective Chiefs in the obligations and techniques of
good supervision.

Any law or decree or provision of law or decree inconsistent with the Decree is hereby repealed
or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 26th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
